cases.text: Ate here Saturday night. By 2am my husband and I were both throwing up and we had diarrhea all Sunday. Pretty sure it was the crab legs. Never again.
Loved the sushi and the dessert bar was great, staff super friendly! Only thing, my daughter had a stomach ache that night but she might have just eaten too much lol. Will be back!
I told the server twice that my son has a severe peanut allergy and asked which dishes had nuts. She said the noodles were safe. He broke out in hives within ten minutes and we had to use his EpiPen.
Great selection. Be careful though, the shrimp dumplings aren't labeled and I react badly to shellfish, found out the hard way when my lips started swelling. Otherwise good food.
Bit into something hard in the fried rice. It was a small piece of glass. I showed the manager and he just shrugged.
Food was ok but there was a dead fly floating in the hot and sour soup tray. Kind of ruined it for us.
昨天中午在这里吃完，晚上全家都拉肚子，孩子还吐了两次。海鲜肯定不新鲜。
在甜品里吃到一根很长的头发，太恶心了，跟服务员说了也没人理。
我跟服務員說我對花生過敏，他說這道菜沒有花生，結果吃完喉嚨腫起來，很可怕。
Food is good and the price is ok. 但是我老公吃完寿司以后肚子疼了一晚上。
The hostess seated every white family right away and made us wait 40 minutes even though there were empty tables. When my husband asked why, she said "your people always complain". Disgusting.
I slipped on the wet floor by the dessert station and there was no sign. My lawyer will be contacting you, and I have already reported this to the county health department.
The manager kicked us out for no reason. I know where you park. Next time I come back you'll regret it.
The cashier charged us twice and refused to fix it, then he started yelling at my wife in front of everyone when she asked again.
服务员态度极差，还多收我们钱。我已经投诉到消协，下一步找律师起诉你们。
La comida se veía bien pero mi esposo y yo nos enfermamos esa misma noche, con vómito y diarrea.
Decent variety, but the chicken on the buffet was pink and raw inside, and the sushi was sitting warm under the heat lamps the whole time.

The plates on the stack were still greasy with bits of dried food stuck to them, and I watched a cook at the grill wipe his nose with his hand and go straight back to plating meat. No soap in the restroom either.
盘子和筷子都油腻腻的，上面还粘着上一桌的饭粒。洗手间脏得没法进，地上全是水和纸。
The shrimp smelled sour and the potato salad had clearly gone off. Half of the hot trays were lukewarm at best. Nobody in our group got sick, but I wouldn't risk it again.
Nos atendieron al último y la mesera se burló de nuestro acento delante de otros clientes. Dijo que "los que no hablan inglés" tenían que esperar. Nos sentimos humillados.
Our server smelled of alcohol and was slurring his words. Then he pocketed the cash another table had left for the bussers, right in front of us.
Worst buffet ever, you people ripped me off. I'm coming back tonight and I will smash every window in this place.
